intentions.title: Prove the Next.js SDK consumption path with a real, working demo site (not a toy)
intentions.evidence: web/AGENTS.md: 'web/ is the read-only Next.js demo consuming the Phoenix API'; posts-list.tsx renders 'Headless CMS demo' from the production dataset; live-bridge.tsx wires @barkpark/nextjs's <BarkparkLive/> for realtime; components consume @barkpark/core client end-to-end.

intentions.title: Ship a unified master/detail Finder — instant search, cross-engine (Postgres vs Indx), with explainable match-quality signals instead of opaque scores
intentions.evidence: finder.tsx: partitionExact() promotes exact substring hits above fuzzy trigram noise; matchSnippet() builds contextual snippets around the actual matched term; matchQuality is deliberately qualitative ('title'/'body'/'partial'/'fuzzy') because 'Postgres ts_rank, Indx BM25F, and fuzzy trigram aren't comparable across engines'; recordFindEvent posts correction/click telemetry.

intentions.title: Ship an Obsidian-style interactive documentation graph that stays wired to live Finder search state
intentions.evidence: graph-landing.tsx: canvas graph on '/' right pane; node click swaps only the (finder) route segment so left-rail search state in the query string survives; useGraphMatches ties node brightness to search rank; onNodeHover cross-highlights the matching finder result row; graph-view.tsx is the Canvas renderer React bridge.

intentions.title: Render every PortableDoc block type (rich text marks, wikilinks, task boards, sheets, roadmaps) faithfully on the read surface, matching the Studio editor's serialization
intentions.evidence: portable-doc.tsx: renderInline/wrapMark handle strong/em/strike/underline/code/link marks matching serializer order; wikilink nodes render an unresolved-target affordance with data-wikilink hook for a future resolver; imports SheetSnapshot, taskBoardColumns, statusLegendProjection/roadmapProjection — one renderer for many embedded block kinds.

intentions.title: Render spreadsheet (Sheets plugin) data losslessly in read-only paper embeds: merges, formats, row heights, checkboxes — without a client-side formula engine
intentions.evidence: sheet-grid.tsx: DenseSnapshot comment states 'there is no formula engine on this side'; splitRowHeights/withCheckboxFmts re-derive Studio-parity rendering (row_heights keying 'twin of the Studio's Geometry.row_px/2', checkbox fmt recovery) purely from the server-precomputed snapshot.

intentions.title: Keep the demo tenancy-aware: workspace/project scoped routing degrades honestly when no list endpoint exists, never fabricating data
intentions.evidence: workspace-project-switcher.tsx: with no `options` renders a static 'w/<workspace> · p/<project>' label instead of a fake switcher; when another workspace's projects aren't fetched yet, renders a disabled single-option select rather than guessing — explicit comments reject fabrication.

intentions.title: Give the map/listings surface a zero-dependency, degrade-gracefully rendering path — no npm map libs, works with tiles off
intentions.evidence: listings-map.tsx: 'ZERO npm map libs (no Leaflet / Mapbox / MapLibre), ZERO build-time tile bundle'; tiles are optional and 'with tiles off (or blocked) the pins still render over a calm graticule, so the surface never collapses to a blank box'; shares the same finder↔pane bridge contract (matches/hoveredId/onHover) as the graph.

intentions.title: Make live/realtime content updates opt-in and inert by default so the demo never surprises an unprovisioned deployment
intentions.evidence: live-bridge.tsx: gated behind NEXT_PUBLIC_BARKPARK_LIVE=1, 'stays inert (no connection attempts, no console noise) until... explicitly switched on'; routes through a same-origin proxy so the browser client carries no token.

intentions.title: Give the demo an honest, empirical way to compare search engines (Postgres vs Indx) instead of trusting vendor claims
intentions.evidence: bench.tsx: fixed QUERIES set, RUNS=6 samples per cell reporting median client round-trip AND upstream server time separately, 'Search is always direct (no cache), so this measures the real engine + network round-trip'.

intentions.title: Keep visual identity single-sourced from the emitted design-token pipeline, never hand-picked colors, across the whole component surface
intentions.evidence: styleguide.tsx: 'Every swatch is painted with var(--color-…), resolving live from the GENERATED block in app/globals.css (emitted by design/emit.mjs from design/tokens.json)'; listings-map.tsx pulls canvas.primary/mutedText from lib/tokens.gen instead of hardcoded hex.
